config.completion_rule: Every one of 204 planned conditions has terminal search status. Successful searches store initial/final 64 coordinates, center/spacing checks, search trace, and all three common-noise metric conditions. Unresolved geometry stores attempted budget and reason; it is not a proof of infeasibility.
limitations: Single Ernie template; independent head validation is a separate unstarted stage.
Approximate coordinate anatomical masks are not reviewed hair-free skin masks.
Finite scalp vertex bank, graph-path radius caps and Euclidean chord spacing are numerical approximations; no exact minimum continuous geodesic area claim.
Shared source covariance, conductivity and forward anatomy remain model-conditional; source-domain nearest-GM recovery approximation is retained transparently.
Localization dictionary error floor is reported and must not be relabelled as true human accuracy. No generator leakage into inverse dictionary.

Field and sensitivity guide bounded search; localization is uniformly evaluated afterward, not optimized at every coordinate move. AR selection among finalists is post-search selection, not an independent test.
No classifiers, MI or P300 task performance, clinical accuracy or formal confidence bounds across people.
Layouts use the same reference-calibrated noise distribution but independently seeded Monte Carlo realizations, not paired identical noise; localization ratios retain simulation variability.

metrics.conditional_global: minimum(field_relative,sensitivity_tail,localization_relative); null if any input is null or nonfinite
metrics.localization_relative: candidate_utility/reference_utility; null if reference is nonfinite or <=1e-12
